output.explanation: Checks that any visit of type "COV" has no open issues. Visits of other types, or with no visit_type, are not checked. A COV visit passes only if open_issues is present and equal to 0.
fails_when: visit_type is "COV" and open_issues is missing (null). A missing count is treated as a failure, not as zero.
visit_type is "COV" and open_issues is greater than 0
visit_type is "COV" and open_issues is negative, because only 0 passes
passes_when: visit_type is anything other than "COV" (the comparison is case-sensitive, so "cov" counts as not COV), whatever open_issues is, including missing
visit_type is "COV" and open_issues is exactly 0
